tooltips.oAuthAccount: OAuth account used to authorize Google Data Manager requests for this destination.
tooltips.operatingAccountId: Google Ads customer ID of the operating account that owns the conversion actions. Enter digits only, without hyphens.
tooltips.loginAccountId: Optional manager account customer ID sent as the login customer. Enter digits only, without hyphens; leave blank when signing in directly to the operating account.
tooltips.isActive: Only active destinations are eligible for conversion uploads.
tooltips.lastUploadStatus: Result of the most recent upload attempt for this destination.
tooltips.lastUploadError: Most recent destination-level upload error returned by Google Ads.
